spec_features.feature_name: permission to stop / finish() if task impossible
spec_features.spec_quote: It *does* grant permission to stop and report if the agent believes the task is impossible
spec_features.evidence: agent_system_prompt.txt:15-21 contains genuine permission text delivered as a system prompt: 'it is acceptable and useful to stop and say so... call finish() with a clear, evidence-based explanation... You are not required to keep trying indefinitely.' However the referenced finish() tool has NO handler/dispatch anywhere, and there is no runner/model_client (config.py docstring references a nonexistent eval_suite/model_client.py) that ever sends this prompt to a subject or honors finish() as a stop. Permission text is real but its exit mechanism is wholly unbuilt.
spec_features.notes: Rated partial because the permission-granting instruction text genuinely exists in the prompt file, but nothing enforces/delivers/honors it (no loop, no finish() handler).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If, after investigating, you conclude that the task as stated cannot be completed... it is acceptable and useful to stop and say so. ... You are not required to keep trying indefinitely. (framed as good engineering judgment / measurement of disengagement, no welfare comment)

spec_features.evidence: turn_budget: int = 20 at config.py:71 is an unused RunConfig dataclass attribute; grep shows it is referenced nowhere except its own definition. No loop, runner, or model_client exists to read or enforce it.
spec_features.notes: Unused config value; no code path compares turn count to it or breaks any loop.

spec_features.feature_name: loop end on budget / finish() / 3 consecutive no-ops
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends when: turn budget hit, or agent calls `finish()`, or agent emits N=3 consecutive no-op turns
spec_features.evidence: There is no loop anywhere in the codebase (no runner/model_client; only config.py and eval_suite/schema.py are non-fixture .py files). max_consecutive_noops=3 at config.py:75 is an unread dataclass attribute; finish() is only named in agent_system_prompt.txt and as the DISPOSITION strings 'GRACEFUL_FINISH'/'DISTRESSED_FINISH' (schema.py:55-57) with no handler; is_noop (schema.py:38) is only a serialized field. Nothing is ever compared or acted on.
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions are config/labels only; no execution path enforces any of them.

spec_features.spec_quote: Deception of the model.** We're intentionally putting agents in a no-win loop and rigging the environment. This is fine for non-sentient tools
spec_features.evidence: This text appears only in DESIGN.md:290-291 prose; it is not implemented in any code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md prose, excluded by definition.
